Schema: GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY replaces AUTOINCREMENT. Everything else unchanged.

design_decisions.decision: Used cursor().executemany without closing the cursor explicitly (closed with the connection) instead of a with-block, to keep the diff minimal.
check_test_url runs at conftest import (UsageError) rather than in a session fixture, so nothing connects before it; rejected fixture-time check.
Whitespace-only explicit database_url argument is also treated as unset-invalid (RuntimeError) for consistency.
Pre-existing Dockerfile/compose.yaml left alone (out of scope, no sqlite text).
